text:
carlos: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in duplicate billing when clients reconnect after a late PONG. Console shows a resume count spike for several tenants. Anyone else seeing this?

tammy: I noticed similar in eu-prod ~10:20. Started right after the pingback coalescing canary rolled out.

raj: Could be stale-session detection + route swap. If PONG arrives late we might be creating a new lease instead of marking it a resume.

lena: I pulled logs, here's the sequence I saw: 

```
INFO session=abc123 PING sent
WARN session=abc123 PONG received (latency=870ms)
INFO session=abc123 route=shard-12 bind new-lease
INFO billing session=abc123 charge=1
```

kevin: That matches the hypothesis. Our billing path charges on `bind new-lease`. If we don't dedupe resume vs new bind we double-charge.

carlos: Two asks: 1) quick mitigation to reduce customer impact, 2) a better telemetry label so console can correlate to rollout flags.

ops-bot: Alert: billing-duplication rate for `stream-resume` increased 2.4x over last 10m (eu-prod).

tammy: Quick mitigation idea: extend the server-side PONG grace window from 500ms -> 2s and emit a `late_pong` metric. That should drop the new-lease creation for slow clients.

raj: I worry about hiding regressions though. Instead of only extending the window, can we add a `reconnect_reason` label on quota/billing events: one of {late_pong, auth_reset, network_loss, manual_disconnect}? That makes the console queries straightforward.

lena: Also the console sampling is biting us — resume traces are sampled down to <1% so the canary signal disappears. We need a targeted opt-in sampling for flagged rollouts.

kevin: Long-term fix: make `bind` idempotent for a short TTL keyed by `resume_token`. If we see the same token within X seconds, skip billing. That avoids requiring longer grace windows.

carlos: @lena can you open a dashboard issue linking the resume spike to the canary flag? @kevin I'll start a runtime patch for an idempotent resume check.

lena: Filed DASH-4567 with screenshots and a proposed panel that joins `resume_count` with `rollout_flag=true`. I'll also flip sampling for traces that include that rollout id.

carlos: :thumbsup: I'll prototype a small runtime change: `if resume_token seen_recently => mark as resume && skip_charge`. Will push behind a feature flag.

tammy: For the rollout plan: gate runtime change behind the feature flag and monitor `late_pong`, `resume_dup_billing`, and the new `reconnect_reason` tags.

kevin: Also bump resume-trace sampling to 100% for the feature flag cohorts so ops can validate.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed for pingback-coalesce v0.9 -> rolled back at 2026-03-22T12:03:12 by deploy-bot.

carlos: Good call on rollback. Let's iterate on the idempotency + telemetry before re-releasing the coalescing change.
